text: 中国人民银行与老挝人民民主共和国银行在广西南宁联合举办中老跨境数字支付互联互通启动会。中国人民银行副行长陆磊、老挝人民民主共和国银行副行长苏里萨克·萨姆努翁出席并致辞。
text_en: The People's Bank of China and the Bank of the Lao PDR jointly held the launch meeting for China-Laos cross-border digital payment connectivity in Nanning, Guangxi. Lu Lei, Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China, and Soulisak Samnouvong, Deputy Governor of the Bank of the Lao PDR, attended and delivered speeches.
